care.soil: Chunky aroid mix: bark, perlite and peat

facts: The holes in its leaves are called fenestrations.
Young leaves are solid; splits appear as the plant matures.
In the wild it climbs trees using aerial roots.
Its ripe fruit tastes like a mix of pineapple and banana.
healthNotes: Healthy overall. One lower leaf shows slight yellowing, likely natural ageing.
